store.note/welcome:
# Welcome to fictty

This whole screen is one JSON value: an input, a list and this editor.
The editor is caretline, a text engine with Helix's model inside.

## Things to try
- Type here. Ctrl-Z and Ctrl-Y undo and redo, in steps of typing.
- Shift and the arrows select. Ctrl-C, Ctrl-X and Ctrl-V copy, cut and paste.
- Tab to the list and pick another note: each keeps its own caret.
- Press Esc, open another chapter, come back. Nothing is lost.

## Where the text lives
Every note is an entry in the store (`note/welcome`), apart from the UI.
A push replaces the screen; it never touches the store. Agents write
with a revision (`--if-rev`), so they can't overwrite what you just typed.
